recordLookups.name: Lookup_ChangeRequest
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the ChangeRequest record by Id to display context information and prepare for update
recordLookups.label: Lookup ChangeRequest

recordUpdates.name: Update_ChangeRequest_Assessment
recordUpdates.description: Updates the ChangeRequest record with the three technical assessment values collected from the screen
recordUpdates.label: Update ChangeRequest Assessment

screens.name: Technical_Assessment_Screen
screens.description: Screen displaying ChangeRequest context (Description, Scope Type) and collecting technical assessment inputs (Cost Impact, Schedule Impact Days, Technical Impact)
screens.label: Technical Assessment Screen

fields.name: changeRequestDescription
fields.description: Read-only display field showing the Description from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.name: changeRequestScopeType
fields.description: Read-only display field showing the Scope Type from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.helpText: Enter the estimated cost impact of this change request
fields.name: costImpact
fields.description: Input field for engineer to enter the cost impact assessment as currency value

fields.helpText: Enter the number of days this change will impact the schedule
fields.name: scheduleImpactDays
fields.description: Input field for engineer to enter the schedule impact in days as numeric value

fields.helpText: Provide a detailed assessment of the technical impact
fields.name: technicalImpact
fields.description: Large text area input field for engineer to enter detailed technical impact assessment

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input variable that receives the ChangeRequest record Id when the flow is launched
